notes: Sprite Shoujo (r7, cut from hima-base): shoulder-length bob with staggered strand tips, fringe swept to the viewer's left (skin reveal over the right eye, part wedge upper-right), a tall outlined ahoge and a 2-px star glint in each open eye; face, dress, arms and motion are the base's. Per tier - sleep: ahoge droops, zzZ; bored: blink/crown slip carry over, tips puff 1 px in frame 4; cruise: ahoge and bob tips drift left 1-2; fast: ahoge whips 45deg, left bob streams as a notched wing with speed lines; top: sparkle eyes, near-horizontal ahoge, longest wing + stars. Streams left; feet never move.
